# Hugging Face

> > The AI community building the future: a comprehensive platform for discovering, sharing, and collaborating on open-source machine learning models, datasets, and applications.

Hugging Face is the leading hub for the machine learning community, providing access to hundreds of thousands of pre-trained models, datasets, and interactive spaces. The platform supports multiple frameworks including PyTorch and TensorFlow, and offers enterprise solutions with compute resources, storage, and deployment infrastructure for organizations of all sizes.

## Key Topics

- Transformers
- Models
- Datasets
- Spaces
- Inference Endpoints
- PyTorch
- Diffusers
- Open Source
- GPU Compute

- Text-to-Speech
- LLMs
- Enterprise Solutions
- AI Community
- Model Sharing

## Core Platform

- [Hugging Face Homepage](https://huggingface.co): AI community platform for open source and democratized ML
- [Models Hub](https://huggingface.co/models): Explore and discover machine learning models across frameworks
- [Datasets Repository](https://huggingface.co/datasets): Discover and browse datasets for machine learning
- [Spaces](https://huggingface.co/spaces): Interactive ML app directory with community-built demos and showcases

## Infrastructure & Services

- [Storage Buckets](https://huggingface.co/storage): Object storage solution for ML data management and deployment
- [Pricing Plans](https://huggingface.co/pricing): Pricing for Hub, Spaces, storage, ZeroGPU, and inference services
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://huggingface.co/enterprise): Team and enterprise plans with SSO, security, access controls, and compute resources

## Documentation

- [Documentation Hub](https://huggingface.co/docs): Comprehensive guides for Hub, libraries, deployment, and ML tools integration

## Featured Models

- [Mistral Small 4 119B](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603): Hybrid MoE LLM with reasoning and multimodal capabilities
- [Qwen3.5 27B Claude Reasoning Distilled](https://huggingface.co/Jackrong/Qwen3.5-27B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled): Fine-tuned reasoning LLM distilled with Claude-4.6-Opus capabilities
- [Qwen3.5 35B Uncensored](https://huggingface.co/HauhauCS/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive): Qwen3.5 35B uncensored LLM variant with quantization options
- [Fish Audio S2 Pro](https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro): Multilingual text-to-speech model with prosody control
- [Baidu Qianfan-OCR](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Qianfan-OCR): Vision-language model for document intelligence and extraction

## Featured Datasets

- [Step-3.5-Flash SFT Dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash-SFT): Supervised fine-tuning data for chat model training
